name: Mech Bunker
description: A Directorate forward hangar for a single Frame, cut into a hillside: an angular hardened hangar with chamfered blast-deflecting front corners, flanking earth-revetment wings flaring out from the entrance, a rear berm wrapping the hangar where it meets the slope, a separated auxiliary-power shed (real bunker doctrine keeps generators away from the main structure), a guard post at the apron mouth, a fan-shaped apron widening toward the access road, and a looped perimeter patrol track (a line part, not a filled area -- see map-template.schema.json's 'kind'). Local +Y is the template's own north (into the hillside); the entrance/apron face -Y (south), so at rotation=0 the road approaches from the south. Roughly 130m x 115m overall including the patrol loop -- site clearance must account for the whole footprint, not just the hangar.
